provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Read complete retained HTML and all 2,079 lines of sources.md, both research files and verification records. Inspected all five workbook sheets read-only with formulas and caches; all 1,699 formulas and cached numeric values matched the full source ledger. No save or engine recalculation.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Original public research used existing DeTars managed detars, research and search-plain browser paths for some fetches/searches; guaranteed-clean session condition was not met. Retained disclosure reports no personal sign-in import, cached third-party credential use, account activity, forms or external contact. Original final HTML browser tests used separate zero-cookie contexts. Those are original-run observations, not new browser tests.
provenance.supersededDrafts: sources.md director verification at lines 316–317 and verification.md supersede the tariff draft: all three Nectr BPIDs and Energex limits were verified in the retained run; state closure-document gaps remained unresolved.

datePolicy: Dates are retained source-specific Brisbane dates, not refreshed at authoring. S1–S16 explicitly record November 7, 2026 access; historical S17–S18 lack a completed source access date and are unknown, with failed retrieval disclosed. Undated publications remain undated. UTC research timestamps on November 6 do not change the Brisbane November 7 source date.
uncertainties: Three exact tariffs are one retailer's restricted existing-customer offers, not an eligible new-customer shopping shortlist. Household postcode, NMI, meter and network tariff eligibility are unknown. Prices vary; no legacy 44c entitlement assumed.

27c import, $1.18/day supply and 4c feed-in calibrate the bill; they are assumptions, not a verified offer. Illustrative TOU 45/28/20c rates are not Nectr rates. Compare final bills, not only larger savings. Solar Sharer extracted timezone unspecified.

Published prices are dated advertisements, national indexes or estimates, not site-specific quotes. No exact Solar Choice 6.6kW index, Brisbane 13kWh average, filtered Brisbane SolarQuotes 10kW series or four like-for-like installer quotes. Net discounts must not be deducted twice.

SolarQuotes equipment/installed inconsistency; iDeal panel arithmetic, identity and hybrid-compatibility gaps; Solargain small-bundle installation/GST/rebate/expiry basis incomplete. Sizes outside target remain labelled.

No verified open owner-occupier Queensland grant or state interest-free loan counted. Historical Battery Booster/loan closure documents not retrieved; no exact closure dates claimed. Rental rebate is for eligible rented properties, not owner occupation.

Federal eligibility and installation-date factors require confirmation for the actual battery and premises. STC price/agent fees vary; future expansion may lose subsidy. VPP capability does not mandate joining.

Annual energy matching is approximate: no interval, clipping, seasonal mismatch, backup reserve, standby, outage or power-limit simulation. Solar-only battery charging; no VPP/grid-arbitrage cash revenue. Supply charges remain.

First-year static simple payback differs from degradation-adjusted elapsed break-even. Ten-year model holds nominal tariffs/costs constant; no finance, inflation, replacement or terminal value. Maintenance provision is $100/year for solar-only and combined.

Wait assumes unchanged net 2028 price, not unchanged subsidy or a forecast. Future multiplier must include market and STC changes. EV assumes daytime availability; no petrol savings or charger cost credited.
Energex normal/export maximum figures are not a property-specific connection guarantee. Installer, product, licence, roof, warranty and complete scope checks remain separate.
Workbook is unchanged. Current task compared retained formulas/caches read-only and did not rerun the original calculation engine or browser tests. Static guide will not update after workbook edits.
editingContract: English-only assigned new guide and semantic record, plus optional scoped notes. Original-stage2-relative links retained for builder rebasing. No shared inventory, renderer, README, existing pages or source-run edits; no build, external research, contact or publication. No ratings or review schema.

audience.en: A northside Brisbane owner-occupier family of four comparing solar and a battery against an approximately AUD 2,600 annual bill, with a possible EV in 2028.

localeReason: English only: the decision depends on a specific Brisbane household, Australian tariff and program eligibility. No distinct Chinese-speaking audience was established; no Chinese version is claimed.
